writing.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
writing.prompt: The diagram shows the floor plan of a public library 20 years ago and how it looks now.

writing.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
writing.prompt: Many manufactured food and drink products contain high levels of sugar, which causes many health problems. Sugary products should be made more expensive to encourage people to consume less sugar. Do you agree or disagree?
